title: Output edge coupler EC#13 at y=-187.5, 3.0 um off the 127 um fibre-array pitch (intent y=-190.5)
evidence: rv.instances(): edge_coupler...#13 origin (2700.0, -187.5), angle 180. Intent table: outputs +444.5 to -444.5, 127 apart, so the 6th output must be at -190.5. Measured y of the 8 output facets: 444.5, 317.5, 190.5, 63.5, -63.5, -187.5, -317.5, -444.5; pitches 127,127,127,127,124.0,130.0,127. route_out_5#28 uses its own s-bend cell (s_bend__F77T3K..., dy=58.85 um, dx=123.97 um, R=80) instead of the 61.85 um s-bend used by the other 7 outputs, so the routing was made to follow the moved coupler; the extraction connects it (N4 = EC#13.P0 - MMI#6.P1), so LVS does not see it. The SLAB_NEGATIVE window moved with it (-197.5..-177.5).
impact: With a 127 um pitch fibre array aligned on the other 7 channels, channel 6 (EC#13) is 3.0 um off the fibre axis. Gaussian overlap with ~3 um MFD (w=1.5 um): exp(-d^2/w^2)=exp(-4) -> about 17 dB extra loss; the channel is dead. Best-compromise array shift cannot fix it (shift 0.375 um: still ~13 dB on EC#13). Also makes path 6 1.48 um shorter (see length finding).
fix: Place EC#13 at (2700, -190.5) and route MMI#6.P1 with the same 61.85 um s-bend (s_bend__DDSVW...) as the other outputs.

title: route_l1_1 (MMI#1.P1 -> MMI#3.P0): vertical straight shifted 0.3 um sideways from both R=80 bends (two 0.3 um lateral steps)
evidence: rv.cell_shapes('route_l1_1'): vertical LN_RIDGE straight spans x 656.55..657.55 (centre 657.05) for y -174.0..-81.65, while both 90-deg bends end at x 656.25..657.25 (centre 656.75). rv.cross_section(656.9, y, 90): ridge at s=-0.35..0.65 for y=-81.6 and y=-174.1 (bend), s=-0.65..0.35 for y=-81.7..-173.9 (straight): a 0.30 um step at y=-81.65 and at y=-174.0. The mirror route route_l1_0 has its straight on the bend axis (x=656.75). The route ends meet the MMI pins on axis, so LVS connects it (N10). rv.junction_loss(1.0, 1.0, offset=0.3) = 0.90 dB per step.
impact: About 0.9 dB per step, ~1.8 dB in total (mode-overlap estimate; part of the light radiates in the 92 um straight) on the lower half of the tree: outputs EC#12..EC#15 (4 of 8 channels) are ~1.8 dB weaker than EC#8..EC#11; the split is no longer uniform. Intent violation: 'every route meets ... on axis, end to end' and the 0.05 dB unplanned-loss limit.
fix: Move the vertical straight of route_l1_1 to x centre 656.75 (x 656.25..657.25), the mirror of route_l1_0.

title: route_l2_2 (MMI#3.P2 -> MMI#6.P0): 10 um gap in the LN_RIDGE at x 1546.85..1556.85, y=-127 (open; slab only)
evidence: rv.cell_shapes('route_l2_2'): the straight is two ridge pieces, x 1332.954..1546.846 and 1556.846..1700.0 (both 1.0 um wide, y -127.5..-126.5); rv.cross_section(1550,-127,0): LN_RIDGE none, LN_SLAB -5..5 (slab continuous, plus a 10x1 um LN_SLAB patch in the gap). rv.lvs(): design_only net [MMI#3.P2, MMI#6.P0]; extraction gives one-pin nets N15/N16. Ridge lengths 216.487+213.892+10+143.154 = 583.53 um, so the length intent is met if the ridge is restored.
impact: Light crosses 10 um of 200 nm slab with no lateral guide: in-plane diffraction (mode 1/e half-width ~0.66 um, Rayleigh length ~1.4 um) plus two ridge/slab mode mismatches: estimate 5 to 7 dB extra loss on outputs EC#12 and EC#13; a severely broken branch of the 1x8.
fix: Fill the ridge between x=1546.846 and 1556.846 at y=-127 (1.0 um wide), or redraw route_l2_2 as the mirror of route_l2_1.

title: route_in (EC#0 -> MMI#1.P0): 0.5 um gap in the LN_RIDGE at x 489.239..489.739, y=0, on the common input path
evidence: rv.cell_shapes('route_in'): LN_RIDGE pieces x 360.0..489.239 and 489.739..500.0 (1.0 um wide); LN_SLAB continuous 360..500 (10 um wide). rv.cross_section(489.5, 0, 0): no LN_RIDGE. rv.lvs(): design_only net [EC#0.P0, MMI#1.P0]; one-pin nets N0/N9 in extraction. Length 129.239+0.5+10.261 = 140.0 um, as intended once filled.
impact: Every one of the 8 outputs passes through it. Diffraction over 0.5 um is small (~0.06 dB in-plane estimate) but the two abrupt ridge->slab->ridge steps scatter light: estimate 0.1 to 0.5 dB on all channels (physics reviewer to confirm with a solve). Above the 0.05 dB unplanned-loss limit; an LVS open.
fix: Fill the ridge between x=489.239 and 489.739 (1.0 um wide, y -0.5..0.5).

title: route_out_6 (MMI#7.P2 -> EC#14): Manhattan route with two 90-deg bends of R=25 um (< 80 um rule) and +21.1 um extra path length
evidence: rv.instances(): route_out_6#29 = bend__3YCEX (bbox 30x30 um incl. slab, ridge 1776.75..1802.25 x -379.85..-354.35) + 11.85 um vertical straight + bend__ZZB36 + 513.25 um straight; centre-line radius 25.0 um (ridge outer edge 25.5 um from the centre). All other 7 outputs use R=80 or R=100 s-bends. Ridge length 39.303+11.85+39.302+513.25 = 603.705 um against 582.614 um for the mirror route_out_7 path: +21.09 um. rv.modes(bend_radius=25) TE0: 38.4 dB/cm radiation (R=80: 0.02 dB/cm).
impact: Radiation alone 2 x 39.3 um x 38.4 dB/cm = 0.30 dB, plus 4 straight/bend mode-mismatch transitions at R=25 (not counted): about 0.3 to 0.6 dB extra on output EC#14. Path to EC#14 is 21.1 um longer than the reference (intent: equal within +-0.5 um): ~154 fs group-delay skew (n_g 2.19), phase not matched. Breaks two explicit rules (R>=80, equal length).
fix: Replace with the 61.85 um R=80 s-bend used by route_out_2/4 (s_bend__2Q3BG7..., dx 126.36 um) and a 436.89 um straight.

title: route_l2_3 (MMI#3.P1 -> MMI#7.P0): 367 um straight drawn 0.6 um wide instead of the 1.0 um RWG1000 ridge (abrupt width steps)
evidence: rv.cell_shapes('route_l2_3'): straight LN_RIDGE x 1332.954..1700.0, y -381.3..-380.7 (0.6 um); rv.cross_section(1500,-381,0): ridge 0.6 um. The s-bend before it is 1.0 um; the MMI#7 input is 1.0 um, so there are abrupt 1.0->0.6->1.0 um steps at x=1332.954 and x=1700.0. Area-based length in rv.optical_net_geometry() reads 436.7 um only because of the narrow width; true centre-line length 216.49+367.05 = 583.53 um (matched). rv.modes: w=1.0 n_eff 1.7915 n_g 2.1898; w=0.6 n_eff 1.7416 n_g 2.1505. rv.junction_loss(1.0,0.6) = 0.030 dB per step.
impact: ~0.06 dB extra loss on outputs EC#14/EC#15 (above the 0.05 dB limit), and the optical length of the branch changes: delta n_eff x L = 0.0499 x 367 um = 18.3 um of optical path (74 rad of phase) and delta n_g x L = 14.4 um of group path (~48 fs, equivalent to 6.6 um of route length) against the other three level-2 branches. Breaks 'no width changes' and the matched-path intent; also 0.6 um is less robust to CD variation than 1.0 um.
fix: Draw the straight 1.0 um wide (y -381.5..-380.5), like route_l2_0.

title: route_l1_0 (MMI#1.P2 -> MMI#2.P0): 2 um long 0.4 um wide neck in the vertical straight at x=656.75, y 136.72..138.72
evidence: rv.cell_shapes('route_l1_0'): the vertical straight is three pieces: 1.0 um (y 81.65..136.718), 0.4 um (x 656.55..656.95, y 136.718..138.718), 1.0 um (y 138.718..174.0). rv.cross_section(656.75,137.7,90): ridge 0.4 um. Area/width length of net N11 reads 705.757 um only because of the neck; true centre-line length 706.958 um equals the lower branch (706.953 um). rv.junction_loss(1.0,0.4) = 0.167 dB per step.
impact: Two abrupt 1.0->0.4->1.0 um steps: ~0.2 to 0.35 dB extra loss on the upper half of the tree (outputs EC#8..EC#11). Breaks 'no width changes'. 0.4 um is above the 0.25 um minimum width, so the basic DRC does not flag it.
fix: Draw the vertical straight as one 1.0 um piece (x 656.25..657.25, y 81.65..174.0).

title: route_out_1 (MMI#4.P1 -> EC#9): s-bend drawn with R=100 um instead of R=80; path to EC#9 is 2.28 um shorter than the others (intent +-0.5 um)
evidence: route_out_1#24 uses s_bend__VNNUN6... (dx 144.62 um, dy 61.85 um); circle fits to its ridge edges give 99.5/100.5 um, centre R=100 um; the other 61.85 um output s-bends (route_out_0/2/3/4/7) are dx 126.36 um, R=80. Ridge length 161.70 + 418.63 = 580.33 um vs 582.61 um. Full input-facet-to-output-facet lengths (work/intent/path_lengths.py; EC 360 um x2, MMI 76.75 um x3, gaps counted as filled): EC#8 2963.353, EC#9 2961.070 (-2.28), EC#10/11 2963.353, EC#12 2963.349, EC#13 2961.865 (-1.49, see intent-1), EC#14 2984.440 (+21.09, see intent-5), EC#15 2963.348.
impact: No extra loss (R=100 is fine for the radius rule). Breaks the equal-length intent by 4.6x the tolerance: 16.6 rad optical phase and ~17 fs group delay on output EC#9 relative to the others; matters only if the 8 outputs are used coherently or timed.
fix: Use the R=80, dx=126.36 um s-bend (as route_out_0) followed by a 436.89 um straight.

evidence: rv.instances(): mmi1x2...#5 origin (1725.3, 127.0), input pin at x=1700.3; the other stage-3 MMIs are at 1725.0 (input 1700.0). route_l2_1 straight ends at 1700.3 (367.346 um, +0.3) and route_out_2/3 straights start at 1903.409 (436.591 um, -0.3); path lengths through MMI#5 (EC#10/EC#11) = 2963.353 um, equal to EC#8 within 0.002 um. title: Update of intent-5 (not a new defect): route_out_6 R=25 bends cost ~1.0 dB, not 0.3-0.6 dB, once the bend/straight mode mismatch is counted
evidence: work/intent/bend_transition.py (local solves, rv._solve straight vs rv._solve(bend_radius=R), E x H overlap): straight<->bend TE0 overlap loss 0.178 dB per transition at R=25 (0.013 dB at R=80). route_out_6 has 4 such transitions (MMI->bend, bend->straight, straight->bend, bend->straight): ~0.71 dB, plus 0.30 dB radiation from rv.modes(bend_radius=25) (38.4 dB/cm x 78.5 um). Total ~1.0 dB (range 0.9 to 1.4 dB, coherent effects in the 11.85 um straight not modelled).
impact: Output EC#14 ~1 dB down from the R=80 design, at the 1 dB "critical" line of the intent loss budget; plus +21.09 um path length (intent-5).
fix: As intent-5: R=80 s-bend (dx 126.36 um, dy 61.85 um) and a 436.89 um straight.

title: Confirm rules-1 (= intent-4): 0.5 um input ridge gap, medium; independent EME bracket 0.08 to 0.6 dB
evidence: work/intent/gap_eme.py: eigenmode expansion through the bare 10 um x 200 nm slab strip, 80 local modes: T(0)=0.886 (basis incomplete), T(0.5 um)=0.870 -> 0.60 dB raw, 0.08 dB after normalising by T(0). The basis misses substrate radiation, which rules-1's 2D x-z solve (0.62 dB) includes, so 0.1 to 0.6 dB is the range; both put it in medium (0.1 to 1 dB) on all 8 outputs.
impact: 0.1 to 0.6 dB on every output; LVS open.

title: Confirm rules-2 (= intent-3): 10 um ridge gap in route_l2_2 is high; independent EME gives 4.7 to 5.3 dB
evidence: work/intent/gap_eme.py, L=10 um: T=0.298 raw (5.26 dB), 0.336 normalised (4.73 dB); rules-2 estimates ~6 dB with a 2D vertical + Gaussian lateral model. All three estimates are far above 1 dB.

fix: Restore the 1.0 um ridge over x 1546.846..1556.846.

title: Confirm twins-5: R=25 bend/straight mismatch 0.178 dB per transition; route_out_6 ~0.9 to 1.0 dB total (borderline medium/high)
evidence: My work/intent/bend_transition.py gives the same 0.178 dB (R=25) and 0.013 dB (R=80) per transition as twins-5; with 0.30 dB radiation the total is 0.96 dB (twins-5 subtracts the R=80 floor: 0.96 -> ~0.9). See intent-5-update. At the 1 dB line; I rate it high because of the coherent uncertainty between the two bends (range 0.9 to 1.4 dB) and because it also breaks R>=80 and the +-0.5 um length rule by 21 um.
fix: R=80 s-bend as the other outputs.
